user.title: Connect your Daikin HomeHub
user.description: Enable unencrypted Modbus TCP and the matching use case on HomeHub first. Select the equipment profile using its model code and Micon ID. A successful read confirms the interface responds; it cannot verify model, firmware or installed accessories.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection or equipment profile
reconfigure.description: Common entity IDs and options are preserved. Entities outside the new profile are removed after successful setup; update automations using those entities.

installation.title: Describe your installation
installation.description: Match these choices to your installed equipment and its existing configuration. They enable related Home Assistant entities; they do not change Daikin installer settings. You can change them later using Configure.

data_description.dhw_present: Enable the DHW controls and related tank, heater and valve measurements.
data_description.additional_zone: Enable additional-zone controls, limits and its thermostat input where supported.
data_description.control_method: Select the main zone control method already configured on the unit. Thermostat inputs remain subject to equipment support.
data_description.cooling_available: Clear this for a heating-only installation to disable cooling entities and the requested operation-mode selector.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read HomeHub. Check the host, port, unit ID, use case and unencrypted Modbus TCP configuration. Another integration may be using conflicting connection settings.
error.invalid_response: The selected register map returned an unexpected probe value. Check the HomeHub use case, equipment profile and firmware.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname or IP address, an integer TCP port (1-65535), unit ID (1-247) and a supported equipment profile.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while checking HomeHub. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.invalid_installation: Choose valid installation options and a listed control method.

abort.already_configured: This endpoint and unit ID are already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection and equipment profile were updated.

init.title: Integration options
init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Match any installation choices to your actual equipment; they do not change installer settings. Entity IDs, names and individual disable choices are preserved.
